headlines.description: Cleveland improved on its best start in 20 years by taking full advantage of Andy Dalton's miserable night Thursday, beating the Cincinnati Bengals 24-3 and ending one of its most enduring streaks of futility.
headlines.shortLinkText: Browns drub Cincy for share of AFC North lead

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: Anthony Sherman recovered a fumble to set up Alex Smith's 8-yard touchdown run with nearly 9 minutes left in allowing the Kansas City Chiefs rally to a 17-13 win over the Buffalo Bills on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs stage speedy turnaround to beat Bills

headlines.description: Matthew Stafford led Detroit to another thrilling victory in the final minutes, throwing an 11-yard touchdown pass to Theo Riddick with 29 seconds remaining to lift the Lions to a 20-16 victory over the Miami Dolphins on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lions rally past Dolphins on Stafford's late TD

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Colin Kaepernick completed a 51-yard pass on fourth down to sustain a game-tying drive, Ahmad Brooks sacked and stripped Drew Brees in overtime, and Phil Dawson kicked a 35-yard field goal to cap San Francisco's stirring 27-24 victory over New Orleans.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kaepernick, Niners top Saints in OT thriller

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at New York Jets

headlines.description: Jets stop Big Ben, Steelers in 20-13 victory

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Falcons snap 5-game skid with 27-17 win over Bucs
headlines.shortLinkText: Falcons snap 5-game skid with 27-17 win over Bucs

headlines.description: Tony Romo returned from injury and helped the Dallas Cowboys snap a two-game losing streak, throwing three touchdowns passes Sunday in a 31-17 win over the Jacksonville Jaguars.
headlines.shortLinkText: Romo throws 3 TD in return as Cowboys roll

headlines.description: Ravens pull away to 21-7 win over Titans
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens pull away to 21-7 win over Titans

headlines.description: Peyton Manning overcame a shaky start to throw five touchdown passes in less than 17 minutes and the Denver Broncos handed the Oakland Raiders their 15th straight loss, 41-17 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Peyton, Broncos bounce back, bury Raiders

events.name: St. Louis Rams at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: Carson Palmer went down with a fourth-quarter knee injury, then backup Drew Stanton and the Arizona defense rallied the Cardinals to a 31-14 victory over the St. Louis Rams on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Backup QB Stanton rallies Cards past Rams

events.name: New York Giants at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: Lynch's 4 TDs lead Seahawks past Giants 38-17
headlines.shortLinkText: Lynch's 4 TDs lead Seahawks past Giants

events.name: Chicago Bears at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers threw six touchdown passes to tie the Green Bay game record and match the NFL record for a half, and the Packers routed the reeling Bears 55-14 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Packers slam Bears; Rodgers ties TD mark

headlines.description: Darren Sproles had two touchdowns, Mark Sanchez threw for two scores and the defense sacked Cam Newton nine times to help the Eagles beat the Panthers 45-21 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eagles lower boom on Newton, Panthers in rout
